title: How Saying One Hard Thing Out Loud Changes Who a Godly Man Actually Trusts
caption:
Say the hard thing. Find out which brothers God actually gave you.

Not the group chat. The men who don't flinch when you're honest.

Say the thing you'd rather text. Watch who leans in, not away. Let the silence after it sit. Do it again with the ones who stayed.

You don't find brothers. You find out who already was one.

#faith #brotherhood #christianmen #manofgod #community
